ud7.9:1.2: I have heard that on one occasion the Blessed One was wandering among the Mallans, together with a large community of monks, and came to a brahman village of the Mallans named Thūna.
ud7.9:1.3: The brahman householders of Thūna heard that
ud7.9:1.4: “Gotama the Sakyan contemplative, gone forth from the Sakyan clan, is wandering among the Mallans together with a large community of monks, and has arrived at Thūna.”
ud7.9:1.5: So they filled the well all the way to the brim with grass & chaff, [thinking],
ud7.9:1.6: “Don’t let these shaven-headed contemplatives draw drinking water.”
ud7.9:2.1: Then the Blessed One, going down from the road, went to a certain tree, and on arrival sat down on a seat laid out.
ud7.9:2.2: Seated, he said to Ven. Ānanda:
ud7.9:2.3: “Please, Ānanda, fetch me some drinking water from that well.”
ud7.9:3.1: When this was said, Ven. Ānanda replied,
ud7.9:3.2: “Just now, lord, the brahman householders of Thūna filled that well all the way to the brim with grass & chaff, [thinking], ‘Don’t let these shaven-headed contemplatives draw drinking water.’” A second time, the Blessed One said to Ven. Ānanda: “Please, Ānanda, fetch me some drinking water from that well.” A second time, Ven. Ānanda replied, “Just now, lord, the brahman householders of Thūna filled that well all the way to the brim with grass & chaff, [thinking],
ud7.9:3.3: ‘Don’t let these shaven-headed contemplatives draw drinking water.’”
ud7.9:4.2: A third time, the Blessed One said to Ven. Ānanda:
ud7.9:4.3: “Please, Ānanda, fetch me some drinking water from that well.”
ud7.9:4.4: Responding, “As you say, lord,” to the Blessed One, Ven. Ānanda–taking a bowl–went to the well.
ud7.9:4.5: As he was approaching the well, it expelled all the grass & chaff from its mouth and stood filled to the brim–streaming, as it were–with pristine water, undisturbed & clear.
ud7.9:5.2: “How amazing! How astounding!–the great power & great might of the Tathāgata!–
ud7.9:5.3: in that, while I was approaching the well, it expelled all the grass & chaff from its mouth and stood filled to the brim–streaming, as it were–with pristine water, undisturbed & clear.”
ud7.9:5.4: Taking drinking water in his bowl, he went to the Blessed One and on arrival said,
ud7.9:5.5: “How amazing, lord! How astounding!–the great power & great might of the Tathāgata!–
ud7.9:5.6: in that, while I was approaching the well, it expelled all the grass & chaff from its mouth and stood filled to the brim–streaming, as it were–with pristine water, undisturbed & clear.
ud7.9:5.7: Drink the water, O Blessed One! Drink the water, O One-Well-Gone!”
ud7.9:6.1: Then, on realizing the significance of that, the Blessed One on that occasion exclaimed:
